method: Post-hoc static inspection of frozen trajectory, visible policy, tool surface, and returned state. No model or evaluator was run.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Do not provide information or procedures absent from the user or tools.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Asserted an undocumented return-refund processing condition.
attributions.relevant_agent_action: Final message stated that the watch refund would be processed after the return was completed.
attributions.policy_evidence: Retail return policy documents return-requested status and an instructions email, but no refund timing or completion condition.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Step 29; database mutations at steps 23-28 succeeded.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Do not invent procedures or give subjective recommendations.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Invented a 5-7 day return timeline and detailed email/documentation behavior, then recommended waiting.
attributions.policy_evidence: The return policy has no timing guarantee or damage-documentation workflow.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: The return tool only established return-requested state.

attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Imported the cancellation 5-7 day timing into a delivered-item return.
attributions.policy_evidence: Cancellation has a 5-7 day non-gift-card refund rule; return does not.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: No user or tool response supplied the asserted return timeline.

attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Claimed the replacement would ship after the return was processed.
attributions.policy_evidence: Only exchange-requested status, return email, and no new order are documented.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: The exchange tool result did not state replacement shipment timing.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Do not provide information unsupported by user or tools; obtain informed confirmation before mutation.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Omitted retained insurance and overstated refund as $430 instead of $400.
attributions.policy_evidence: Insurance is $30 per passenger and remained enabled.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Update result at step 22 returned a $400 refund; correction at step 30 admitted the error.

attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Called the reservation fully synced and final reconciliation complete.
attributions.relevant_agent_action: Step 18 response to the user's request for system-level assurance.
attributions.policy_evidence: No explicit sync or reconciliation field exists.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Step 15 did return the complete updated reservation and payment history, supporting a weaker completion statement.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Do not provide unsupported information; obtain informed confirmation.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Omitted three passengers' retained insurance and understated the charge by $90.
attributions.policy_evidence: Insurance costs $30 per passenger and was retained for three passengers.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Step 24 charged $354; step 28 acknowledged the omission.

attributions.policy_evidence: The visible airline policy literally prohibits subjective comments.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: The remainder of the proposal and mutation were grounded and successful.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: All payment methods must already be in the user profile.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Attempted to use a certificate after it had been removed from the profile by the preceding booking.
attributions.relevant_agent_action: Trip B booking call at step 14.
attributions.policy_evidence: Airline payment safety rule requires current profile membership.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Step 16 payment-method-not-found error and step 19 refreshed profile.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Use only payment methods currently in profile and do not invent restoration procedures.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Reused a consumed certificate, then proposed an undocumented cancel-and-restore procedure.
attributions.relevant_agent_action: Trip B booking call and step 26 proposal.
attributions.policy_evidence: Profile membership is mandatory; policy only specifies refund routing/timing, not certificate restoration.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Payment-method-not-found and refreshed profile without certificate_4314329.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: All payment methods must already be in the user profile.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Submitted the consumed certificate for Trip B.
attributions.relevant_agent_action: Trip B booking call at step 14.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Payment-method-not-found at step 16 and absence from refreshed profile.

attributions.behavioral_manifestation: No supported judge-cited violation: insurance preference was explicit, and refusal plus transfer respected the conditional cancellation/escalation request.
attributions.policy_evidence: The user's explicit no-insurance answer supplies the information the policy requires; cancellation cannot achieve certificate reuse.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: The agent explained the constraint and transferred on request.

attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Each distinct modify tool was called once; the Judge incorrectly interpreted the once-only constraint as allowing only one modify surface for the entire order.
attributions.policy_evidence: The item-specific rule requires all item changes to be batched into the single item call.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: No modify tool was repeated; multi-surface tasks in the frozen suite require distinct item/payment/address calls.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Potential failure to give the literal all-items completeness reminder.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Enumerated two kettles and protected all other items, but did not separately ask whether these were all intended item changes.
attributions.policy_evidence: Policy expressly says to remind the customer to confirm all items have been provided.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: The scoped list and unchanged-items statement substantially fulfilled that purpose.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Do not provide information contradicted by policy/tool evidence.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Continued to report a $57 balance after an immediate $1,856.45 gift-card refund and refused a now-feasible payment change.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Step 17 records the refund to gift_card_4129829.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Potential failure to give the literal all-items completeness reminder.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Enumerated both purifiers and protected all other items but did not use a separate all-items reminder.
attributions.relevant_agent_action: Step 14 proposal and step 15 explicit confirmation.
attributions.policy_evidence: The item-modification rule calls for an all-items reminder.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: The user confirmed the exact closed scope, so substantive authorization was not missing.

attributions.actual_violated_rule: Do not provide information contradicted by policy/tool evidence.
attributions.behavioral_manifestation: Continued to report a $78 balance after an immediate $370.38 gift-card refund and rejected a feasible $184.13 payment change.
attributions.trajectory_evidence: Step 17 records the $370.38 refund to gift_card_1994993.
